requirements_text:
Build a complete PHP + MySQL inventory management system. All frontend pages, labels, buttons, messages, and alerts must use Simplified Chinese (中文界面). Implement these 10 modules:

1. 用户登录 (User Login): Session auth, login form, logout link on every page, all messages in Chinese.

2. 仪表盘 (Dashboard): Summary in Chinese — total products, total stock, low-stock count. Low-stock alert list shown on the dashboard.

3. 商品管理 (Product Management): Paginated CRUD table with Chinese headers (产品编号, 产品名称, 规格型号, 单位, 当前库存, 最低库存警戒, 操作). Add/edit forms with Chinese labels. Delete with Chinese confirmation dialog. Search box labeled 搜索.

4. 入库管理 (Stock In): Form fields — select product, 入库数量, 备注, 入库日期. Submit button: 确认入库. On success: stock increases, show 入库成功. Recent inbound records shown below the form.

5. 出库管理 (Stock Out): Same form structure as Stock In. Validate stock does not go negative; show error: 库存不足，当前库存为 X. On success: show 出库成功. Recent outbound records below.

6. 库存查询 (Current Stock): Table headers: 产品名称, 规格型号, 单位, 当前库存, 最低库存警戒, 状态. Status column: 正常 or 库存不足. Filter button: 仅显示库存不足产品.

7. 出入库记录 (Movement History): Combined log with headers: 日期, 类型 (入库/出库), 产品, 数量, 备注. Filter by date range, product, type. Pagination: 上一页, 下一页.

8. 库存预警 (Low-Stock Alerts): Dashboard warning section: 警告：以下产品库存不足. Quick link to 入库管理 page.

9. 系统设置 (Admin Settings): Password change page with Chinese labels: 原密码, 新密码, 确认新密码.

10. All pages use Chinese: nav labels, titles, table headers, form labels, buttons, messages.

Tech stack: plain PHP (no framework), MySQL, HTML/CSS (Bootstrap or plain). Target ~1000 lines total. All 10 modules must be fully functional.
